fire: It is never easy to admit one's mistakes in front of others.
A person should take pride in one's work, however small.
Travel is a good way to broaden one's view of the world.
It takes courage to follow one's conscience against the crowd.
Losing one's keys on a cold night is a miserable thing.
Reading aloud is a pleasant way to improve one's accent.
It helps to know one's limits before a long climb.
There is comfort in returning to one's home after a journey.
quiet: It is never easy to admit mistakes in front of others.
A person should take pride in good work, however small.
Travel is a good way to see more of the world.
It takes courage to stand against the crowd.
Losing the keys on a cold night is a miserable thing.
Reading aloud is a pleasant way to improve an accent.
It helps to rest well before a long climb.
There is comfort in coming back after a journey.
